title.narrative: Activity under preparation Honduras Industrial Green Investment Program (HIGIP)

description.narrative: The Honduras Industrial Inclusive and Green Investment Program (HIGIP) is a comprehensive programmatic action designed to accelerate the country¿s green and inclusive industrial transformation under the Global Gateway Investment Agenda (GGIA). Over four years, the action will combine policy dialogue, regulatory reform, institutional strengthening, digital governance tools and targeted investment preparation to create an enabling environment for sustainable agro-industrial development, with a particular focus on eco-industrial parks and clusters integrating renewable energy, circular economy principles and industrial symbiosis with European industrial added value. Implemented nationwide through a mix of delegated cooperation, technical assistance, calls for proposals and grants, the action will deliver and implement a new national industrial policy, upgraded public financial management and PPP frameworks, strengthened e-governance platforms, and strengthen dialogue with civil society for inclusive agro-industrial development. The expected impact is the mobilisation of private capital of European and international investment into sustainable agro-industry, the creation of quality green jobs, reduced territorial inequalities, and reinforced EU positioning as the leading partner for Honduras¿ inclusive and green industrial transition, linked with the GGIA in the country.
